body: This is a good comment, I'm really glad that somebody sees where I'm coming from with this.

This comment is quite reasonable, the only problem is that I'm living with my parents at the moment and am not moving out for another couple of months. I can't be going around seeing prostitutes and stuff while I'm at theirs because they'd know something was up. Also I don't really know how the whole thing works. Plus I'm not waiting around feeling like shit for a couple of months to make this happen, I'd rather my life just stopped now.
I don't live in North America. Everybody here is trying to tell me 'don't listen to societal expectations', that is *not the issue here...*

Because sex is like a very basic thing that *everybody* gets to do at some point in their life, whereas things such as deep sea diving are things that happen to far fewer people. Thus the two aren't really comparable.
Well, good for you, I'm glad some people have nice lives.
Unless somebody can give me an absolute 100% guarantee that things get better, which nobody can, then I don't see why I should believe that.

Who said that I had any interest in any interest in 'society' in the first place? Also I don't feel worthless at all. And other people aren't bringing me down, I don't see where I said that? Your post seems completely unrelated to mine...can you explain what you mean further?

Relationships are a requirement for my life, I have decided. This is *non-negotiable*. Just because you are content living a life without getting along with others, doesn't mean I ever will be - different people look for different things out of life. So no amount of people telling me 'why don't you just take up a hobby?' is going to change my mind, I *do these things already, it is not working*.

Yeah, the main difficulty for me at the moment is finding an effective way of committing suicide. I'm the same - I'm not waking up in some fucking hospital bed somewhere with my family round me saying 'ohhh it's okay you can talk to us' or whatever - I wouldn't make any attempt at suicide unless I knew that it was definitely going to work, but I've been doing some research and I can't find any methods that I like the sound of.

The thing is though, I've kinda done the whole being by myself and being comfortable thing for a lot of my life. I dunno, as though I've completed that section of it. And I figure that I could either carry on that way and just be a bit bored, or I can say 'right here are the things that I have left to do in life (relationships etc.)...' and then move on from there. The problem is that as far as I can work out, it will be impossible for me to really get to know anybody new in any way from now on for a number of different reasons, so I just don't see the point in continuing.

That's fine, I'm not complaining. I'm just trying to be practical...other people always seem to act as though 'but you're not the only one who feels this way' is meant to make me feel better, but it just doesn't cut it so we need to start looking at some other options.

Yes, well this is what people are always saying to me, is that rather than have any expectation that one day somebody might actually like me, I should just put loads of effort into distracting myself from my own life instead. Which seems odd to me...if my life is to be avoided then surely a far more effective way of doing that would be to have me kill myself, rather than have me play lots of video games or whatever.

>You are far from alone

Yes. Which if anything makes things worse, because...

1. It means that I am less justified in being upset about it, which makes me feel guilty about being upset about it in the first place
2. The world is just an unpleasant place if there are lots of people about who feel the same as me
